sections: Database Schema Design: subscription entitlements, room config versioning, access policy separation
Backend Authorization Strategy: subscription gating, role-based access control, spectator permissions
Team Allocation Atomicity: race condition prevention, Serializable isolation, idempotency
Room Configuration Immutability: state machine, snapshot strategy
Visibility & Discovery: public room discovery, private room access
Financial Data Integrity: purse ledger, BigInt for money
Error Handling: expected vs. unexpected errors, conflict handling

documentation_created.error_codes: SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED, ROOM_NOT_FOUND, CONFIGURATION_INVALID, TEAM_SLOT_TAKEN, ROOM_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, CODE_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED, CODE_MAX_USES_EXCEEDED, etc.

critical_risks: Team allocation race condition: Mitigated by Serializable isolation + unique constraint
Configuration mutable after LIVE: Mitigated by service guard + immutable snapshots
high_risks: Subscription expires mid-auction: Synchronous check at creation; Phase G monitoring
Spectator can bid if permission not enforced: Backend role validation
Team capacity exceeded on role change: No role changes in Phase F; Phase G validates
medium_risks: Invitation code double-use: Serializable isolation on code increment
Private room access leak: Backend authorization checks
low_risks: Subscription limits not enforced: Immutable config + validation
Timezone issues: UTC storage; Phase G real-time sync
documentation_created.recommendations: Subscription monitoring, spectator permissions, admin role changes validation, idempotency keys, audit logging, rate limiting

notes: Integration tests use mocked dependencies (no real database required for unit testing)
E2E tests designed for Playwright; require running API + Web servers
Race condition tests use Serializable isolation which is PostgreSQL-specific
Subscription entitlements model is designed for easy additions (new entitlement keys)
Configuration immutability enforced at service + database level (defense in depth)
All monetary values in BigInt minor units to prevent float precision issues
Invitation code generation uses secure random code (12+ char alphanumeric)
Phase G will add background job for subscription expiration monitoring
Phase G will add admin endpoints for role changes with capacity validation
All tests follow AAA pattern (Arrange, Act, Assert) for clarity
